name: Linux physical capture refusal and guarded conformance execution
scope: Refuse Linux physical camera/microphone acquisition before backend initialization until origin consent mediation exists; preserve Android and non-capture media paths. Separate process guard protects unchanged old binaries during tests.
guard_validation: 10 dummy-only acquisition/refusal/playback checks; rejected ACK, missing nonce, and competing preload terminate before oracle main
not_claimed: No historical hardware access solely from absence of a log
known_capability_change: Linux physical camera and microphone capture intentionally unavailable. enumerateDevices retains one generic audioinput with empty label; camera enumeration is refused before SDL.
runtime_composition: Accepted runtime before flex123, plus only three physical-capture refusal sources; independent geometry and flex changes excluded. Final source branch retains separately accepted flex123.

independent_native_oracle.linked_libraries: libc and loader only; no SDL or capture backend

browser_policy_observations.classification: Direct product-policy validation, not WPT gains

limitations: GUM-deny stops earlier at unsupported testdriver.set_permission and does not validate native denial mapping

spec_basis: The Permission Failure branch permits security/platform limitations and rejects NotAllowedError. This conservative policy does not implement origin consent UI.
android_validation: Linux conditional guards leave Android acquisition branches unchanged; Android device execution was not tested.
noncapture_scope: Synthetic/canvas/file media streams and normal playback remain outside physical-acquisition refusal; unchanged MediaStreamTrackEvent and canvas-capture guards passed.
review_dispositions: Native refusal precedes SDL initialization/enumeration and microphone allocation
Camera policy is checked before enumeration in openCam
Ordinary permission query maps negative native status to denied
No global opt-in bypass is introduced
Old frozen binaries require a separately verified sealed-library/bootstrap acquisition guard
